title: Raw section separated on images of stage covers
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone with vertex $C$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ and $Q$ be precoverages on $F(j)$ and $C$. Every transition functor $F(a)$ and cocone functor $V_j$ is continuous for the generated topologies [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Fix $i\in J$ and a set-valued sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $I=\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $A_t=F(t.hom)_sG$. For $b:t\to t'$ give a sheaf map $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^s A_{t'}$ whose composite with the unit $G\to F(t.hom)^s A_t$ equals the unit at $t'$ componentwise as objects of the arrow category of sets. For $t\in I$ let $B_t$ be a presheaf on $C$, with $\beta_t:A_t\to V_t^p B_t$ exhibiting $B_t$ as the left Kan extension of the underlying presheaf of $A_t$ along $V_t^{op}$. Here $V_t=V_{t.right}$, $V_t^p$ is presheaf restriction, and a left Kan extension means that composition with $\beta_t$ bijects maps $B_t\to T$ with maps $A_t\to V_t^p T$ for every presheaf $T$. Let $B:I\to\mathrm{PSh}(C)$ have these objects and satisfy, for all $b:t\to t'$ and $X\in F(t.right)$, $\beta_t(X)B(b)(V_tX)=\theta_b(X)\beta_{t'}(F(b.right)X)$ as objects of $\mathrm{Arrow}(\mathrm{Set})$.Assume also that the object and arrow cocones of $V$ are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Every $P_j$ has singleton isomorphism covers, covering pullbacks, stability under finite composition and finite base change [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage]. Every covering presieve of $P_j$ has finitely many distinct arrows. Transitions preserve covering presieves and pullbacks along their covering arrows, and their inverse-image functors preserve finite limits. Each $V_j$ preserves covering pullbacks. For every $j\in J$, $X\in F(j)$ and covering presieve $R\in P_j(X)$, the raw presheaf $H_0=\mathrm{colim}\,B$ is separated for $R.map(V_j)$: any two sections in $H_0(V_jX)$ whose restrictions agree along every arrow in that image presieve are equal. This asserts uniqueness only, and no existence of amalgamations or sheaf condition for $Q$.

proof.text:
First compute raw sections by the pointwise Kan formula. A generator is
represented by a stage section and an arrow from the object in the limit site
to the image of its stage object. Move that arrow, its endpoints, and the stage
section to a common stage receiving i and the stage of the object, using the
object and arrow set-colimit hypotheses, and restrict the section along the
lifted arrow. This represents the generator at the lifted object. For any
finite chain of Kan relations, lift its arrows and equations to a later common
stage. Naturality of beta and hβmap identify each lifted relation with section
restriction or transport by theta. Conversely these operations are Kan
relations. Thus two representatives agree precisely when they agree after
further stage refinement. The unit condition hθ identifies theta with the
adjunction transpose of the unit at the target stage; uniqueness of transposes
makes these transports compatible with composition and with the stage sheaves.

proof.text:
For two sections with the same restrictions on the image of a stage cover R,
put their representatives at a common stage receiving that stage and i.
Enumerate the distinct arrows of R, a finite set by hfinite. The finitely many
equalities of restrictions hold at a single further stage by the equality
criterion just established and filteredness. hcover makes the transported R
a stage cover. The stage inverse-image sheaf is separated for this cover,
so the two represented sections are equal there. Their raw colimit classes
are therefore equal. Applying this to two amalgamations gives the assertion.
For the empty cover the stage sheaf has at most one section, so the same
argument applies without any restriction equalities to lift.
